payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baseline models used in the context of speech translation experiments.

claims.text: Pre-training baselines include encoder pre-training from an ASR model, decoder pre-training from an MT model, and encoder-decoder pre-training.
The vanilla ST baseline consists of a speech encoder and a decoder without a text encoder.
Multi-task baselines include one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many settings.
The experimental results show that the proposed model outperforms the baselines by 2.2 BLEU.
